# agentsstandard.com

> The AGENTS.md hierarchical configuration standard for AI agents. One file convention, three scopes, all agents.

## The Standard

Agent tools each invented their own config files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, .clinerules, copilot-instructions.md). This standard unifies them.

One file: `AGENTS.md`. Three scopes:

1. **Global**: `~/.agents/AGENTS.md` — User-level base rules for all projects, all agents
2. **Project**: `.agents/AGENTS.md` at repo root — Team-shared rules committed to version control
3. **Folder**: `.agents/AGENTS.md` in any subdirectory — Component-specific rules

Rules cascade and extend, not replace. Same model as .editorconfig, .eslintrc, .gitignore.

## Resolution Order

1. Load `~/.agents/AGENTS.md` (global)
2. Walk from cwd upward, collect `.agents/AGENTS.md` files (deepest first)
3. If target file is in a subdirectory with its own `.agents/AGENTS.md`, load that too
4. Merge: global as base, each layer adds constraints
5. Conflicts: most specific scope wins (folder > project > global)

## File Format

Plain Markdown. No YAML frontmatter. No schema. Just write rules.

| Agent | Config File | Global Path |
|-------|------------|-------------|
| Pi | AGENTS.md | ~/.agents/AGENTS.md (native) |
| Claude Code | CLAUDE.md | ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md |
| OpenAI Codex | instructions.md | ~/.codex/instructions.md |
| Cursor | .cursorrules | ~/.cursor/rules/ |
| GitHub Copilot | copilot-instructions.md | Settings UI |
| Windsurf | .windsurfrules | ~/.codeium/windsurf/ |
| Cline | .clinerules | ~/.cline/cline_rules |
| Roo Code | .roorules | ~/.roo/rules/ |
| Gemini CLI | GEMINI.md | ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md |

| Mistral Codestral | CODESTRAL.md | — |
| Qwen Code | QWEN.md | — |

## Setup

Create `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`, then symlink to each agent's config location. One source of truth.

See setup script at: https://github.com/nbiish/agentsstandard-dot-com

## Relationship to Agent Skills

- **SKILL.md** (agentskills.io) = what the agent can do
- **AGENTS.md** (agentsstandard.com) = how the agent should behave

They complement each other. Both use the `.agents/` directory convention.
